---
title: Workflow template
description: The MUST list every workflows/* package satisfies — the use workflow / use step split, the CRON_SECRET-protected trigger route, and blast-radius declaration with its gate.
---

One package per scenario (for example `hubspot-clay-sync`), each an
independently deployable app — **Vercel-first; Render acceptable** when
durable-workflow semantics aren't needed. A workflow package **MUST** satisfy
every item below, condensed from
[`workflows/README.md`](https://github.com/nika-loki/paydirt/blob/main/workflows/README.md).

## The MUST list

- [ ] **Keep orchestration in `"use workflow"` functions; all connector I/O in
  `"use step"` functions** (plainly: `use workflow` marks the orchestration
  functions that shape the run, while `use step` marks the connector-I/O
  functions that talk to external systems — a step that only does I/O holds
  no in-run state, which is what makes it safe to retry). The workflow
  declares the shape of the run; steps do the talking to external systems
  through connectors.
- [ ] **Expose one protected route — `POST /api/trigger` — authenticated by
  `CRON_SECRET`.** The same route both starts runs and resumes approval hooks:
  only the owner's cron (or the owner) can fire or resume.
- [ ] **Declare a blast radius in the README** — one of `demo`, `read-only`,
  `writes-internal`, `sends-external` — and carry the matching gate.
- [ ] **Respect `@paydirt/core` semantics**: `DRY_RUN`
  anything-but-literal-`"false"` is dry; budgets and action caps are enforced,
  not advisory.
- [ ] **Ship offline unit tests for steps** and a `.env.example` whose values
  are literally `replace-me`.
- [ ] **Import connectors and `@paydirt/core` only.** Nothing imports from
  `workflows/`.

## Blast-radius classes and their gates

| Class | Example | Gate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `demo` | crm-hygiene (sample mode) | public read-only, `SAMPLE_DATA=true`, rate-limited, zero credentials |
| `read-only` | crm-hygiene (live) | none beyond `CRON_SECRET` |
| `writes-internal` | hubspot-clay-sync | approval hook before first write batch |
| `sends-external` | (future) sequencer | approval hook + production-only sends |

## Environment mapping

| Environment | Deployment |
| --- | --- |
| development | local `pnpm dev` |
| pilot | preview deployment + manual trigger |
| production | production deployment + cron |

Schedule crons at a jittered minute (avoid `:00`) so every deployment doesn't
hit vendors on the hour.

## The human gate

GitHub reviewer approvals map to a Workflow DevKit approval hook — "use without
seeing" carries over: developers deploy and trigger dry runs; only the owner
holds the secret releasing live writes.

    B -->|"resumed approved: true"| C["Write steps execute — DRY_RUN still respected"]

  `}
